title: say panaanap na kaseguroan ed liwawa na bitewen
intro: Imadyin mo ya akaalagey ka ed silong na malaknab a katawenan ed labi, ya nanenengneng mo ray maliwliwawan silew ya ontatagey insan onkupas legan mon aanapen no antoy talagan makanepegan na debosyon. Diad kaliberliber mo, saray mareen ya inukit ya imahen et makakaawat na panangidayew tan apay, balet ta say malinew a rason et mankuestion ed pakayari ra. Say andiay takot a boses so asingger lan mangabet ed atawir a tradisyon tan mangituro ed Manamalsa na katawenan tan dalin.
clues: Ninengneng ko ray bitewen, bulan, tan banwa, tan inisip ko ya ag ira nayarin Katawan ko ta onlelereg tan naandi iratan.
Maparungtal kon impulisay so dadayewen na totook nilikud ed si Allah tan tinawag ko ran mandayew ed Manamalsa labat.
Akitongtong ak ed sakey a mapaatagey a manuley ya mangibabagan sikatoy mangiiter na bilay tan patey, tan inmebat ak diad impangibaga kon si Allah so angitarok na banwa manlapud bukig.
Pinekpek ko ray talintaoy diriyos tan binuyak da ra, a say atilak labat et say sankabalgan ed sikara pian makapawil diman iray totoo.
Siak so inerel tan kinondena na saray totook, ya inkuan dan mangipaalagey na istruktura tan ibuntok da ak ed manliob ya apoy.
Nilaban ak nen ingganggan nen Allah ya say apoy et magmaliw ya ambetel tan maligen parad siak.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Propeta Ibrahim (Abraham)
Propeta Yahya (Juan)
Propeta Al-Yasa (Elisha)
Say Samiri
Namrud (Nimrod)

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Inarap so panagdayew ed idolo tan nandedebati ed kabaliksan na saray celestial bodies
Inakmon na baleg a sira kayari ton tinmaynan ya mapasnok
Inwanwan to ray patumbok to ed dayat ya inapag nen Allah
Pinaoli a mabilay ed tawen ya ag-akataway na patey
Naugip ed ungib a kaiba iray kakaiba to ed loob na dakel a taon
trial.answer: Inarap so panagdayew ed idolo tan nandedebati ed kabaliksan na saray celestial bodies

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say manliob ya apoy ya ginawan ambetel tan maligen nen Allah
Say biong ya angiyakar ed saray mananisia ed delap
Say baston a nagmaliw ya uleg
Say lamisaan so kinmayat manlapud tawen
Say kabatyan a kamelyo so imbaki bilang tanda
location.answer: Say manliob ya apoy ya ginawan ambetel tan maligen nen Allah

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Protektaan ed apoy tan naikdan na matunong iran ilalak
Nalner a kaiba iray mangibuburi ed baleg a delap
Nauman lapud impakasumlang ed Sabaton
Dineral na saray manok ya mangaawit na bato ya pitek
Inakmon na dalin a kaiba iray kayamanan
outcome.answer: Protektaan ed apoy tan naikdan na matunong iran ilalak

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
verse: And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith]. (6:75)
